TC-13/S24.title: Real phone camera: photograph a printed synthetic note
TC-13/S24.detail: Android rig: debug build of main e02167f bundled for the LOCAL stack only (bundle names 127.0.0.1:4510/4511, reached through adb reverse), built outside the checkout, on the rc_api36 emulator (Pixel 7, Android 16); Playwright attached to the app's own WebView; every ai/* action the app sends is answered or failed at the WebView's socket (no model call; aiCallLog had no new row in any run). Our addition (optional per the 10-15 review). With the camera permission granted, Previous Notes -> Photograph on a Hospital chart and on a Nursing Home resident opens Android's photo picker, not the camera (no camera app at all); Back returns to the app, nothing added, no vision call. The same cause as the EFS/S18 camera finding (the manifest has no <queries> entry for the image-capture intent). Left: photographing the printed S03 note with a real camera and reading it (needs the printout and the live vision model).
